title: Sophia Beebe – CV
text:
Software Engineering Student | Robotics & Data Analytics | Project Manager

sophiabeebe1@gmail.com | sophiabeebe.com | LinkedIn | GitHub



Undergraduate Software Engineering student at Brigham Young University of Idaho, specializing in applied robotics, data analytics, and software architecture, with hands-on experience building full-stack and hardware-integrated systems.


Software Engineering, Robotics Automation, Data Analytics, Project Management, Design Patterns, Embedded Systems, Python, C#, SwiftUI




2021 – Present
Brigham Young University–Idaho
Bachelor of Science, Software Engineering

Minor: Data Analytics

Minor: Intercultural Studies

President, Interdisciplinary Studies Club




2024 – 2025
Folding Clothes Robot (Capstone Project)

Designed and built a multi-phase robotic system capable of folding garments

Implemented servo and stepper motor control using Arduino and Python

Integrated mechanical design, electronics, and software architecture

Explored real-world constraints such as torque limits, safety, and repeatability

Developed two robotic approaches and evaluated tradeoffs between them

2025
Sun Buddy (iOS Application Prototype)

Built a SwiftUI prototype for tracking daily sunlight exposure

Designed custom UI components including progress rings and dashboards

Focused on wellness, behavioral design, and data visualization

2025
Hackathon Project – Intelligent Task & Routine Assistant

Collaborated on a rapid-development software project focused on improving executive function and daily task management

Designed and implemented core features under a strict time constraint, prioritizing usability and functional scope

Applied software engineering principles to break down requirements, assign tasks, and deliver a working prototype

Integrated data handling and logic to support task tracking, prioritization, and user interaction

Presented the final product with a live demo, explaining technical decisions and future scalability




2023 – Present
Teaching Assistant, BYU–Idaho

Assisted students with HTML, CSS, Python, R, GitHub workflows, and debugging

Led in-class demonstrations and one-on-one mentoring

Supported grading, rubrics, and project evaluations

2024
Project Manager (Academic)

Elected as Project Manager for a 21-person software engineering class project

Led the end-to-end planning and execution of a large-scale ride-share application

Authored a 200+ page architectural design document detailing system architecture, data flow, APIs, security, and scalability considerations

Coordinated cross-functional teams, resolved scope and timeline challenges, and maintained alignment with academic and technical requirements

Delivered the project at the highest quality level, earning the highest grade ever awarded in the course





Languages: Python, C#, R, Swift, SQL, HTML/CSS

Tools: Git/GitHub, Arduino, Firebase, ROS concepts, Xcode, RStudio

Concepts: Software architecture, data analysis, robotics control, UI design

Soft Skills: Technical communication, mentoring, leadership, project planning





President, Interdisciplinary Studies Club

Certified Yoga Teacher

Academic Project Leadership Recognition
